m3-t1.question: What is application-to-join yield for 12 joins from 200 applications?
What is interview-to-offer conversion for 20 offers from 40 interviews?
m3-t1.explanation: The eligible denominator is interviewed applications.

m3-t1.question: Why can monthly acceptances divided by monthly offers mislead?
options: The events may belong to different cohorts
Months cannot be used in reports
All conversion rates must be identical
m3-t1.explanation: Period flows are not necessarily matched-stage populations.

m3-t1.question: What should accompany a source conversion rate?
options: Counts, cohort definition and role context
m3-t1.explanation: Context and sample size determine interpretability.

m3-t1.question: Is every funnel drop necessarily undesirable?
options: Only if the chart is red
No drop should ever be investigated
No; job-related screening may appropriately reduce the pool
Yes, all applicants must be hired
m3-t1.explanation: Interpret the reason for the drop rather than assuming failure.

m3-t2.question: Under this course convention, what is time-to-fill?
m3-t2.explanation: The convention is stated explicitly because industry definitions vary.

m3-t2.question: What is elapsed time from 1 June to 21 June with start day excluded?
What is cost per hire for ₹60,000 across six hires?
m3-t2.explanation: 60,000/6 = 10,000 under the defined cost and hire boundary.

m3-t2.question: How should unfilled requisitions appear?
options: As open work with age and status
m3-t2.explanation: Completed-duration summaries need complementary open-age visibility.

m3-t2.question: Why is lowest cost per hire not automatically best?
options: All roles cost the same to hire
Quality, fairness and outcomes also matter

m3-t3.question: What is the best basis for a selection scorecard?
m3-t3.explanation: Selection evidence should relate to the role.

m3-t3.question: Two interviewers score 2 and 4. What should happen first?
options: Compare evidence against the scoring anchors
Average and declare all bias removed
m3-t3.explanation: Calibration examines why the scores differ.

m3-t3.question: What is response rate for 18 replies from 30 invitations?
What is a limitation of candidate feedback?
m3-t3.explanation: Voluntary participation can create selection bias.

m3-t3.question: How should criticism of the recruitment process be used?
options: For process improvement, separated from selection judgement
As a reason to reject the candidate
As proof of poor job performance
m3-t3.explanation: Protect feedback integrity and candidate fairness.

questions.question: A mature cohort has 160 applications, 40 interviews, 16 offers and 12 joins. What is application-to-join yield?
Twenty offers issued this month are compared with fifteen acceptances, ten from earlier months. What must be clarified before calling 75% an acceptance rate?
options: Whether offers and acceptances form a matched cohort
Only whether fifteen is a large number
questions.explanation: Unmatched period events may not support cohort conversion.

questions.question: A recent sourcing cohort has many open applications. How should it be compared with a mature cohort?
options: Align observation windows or report incomplete follow-up explicitly
Treat all open cases as failures
Treat all open cases as hires
questions.explanation: Recent cohorts have less time to progress.

questions.question: A requisition is approved on 3 July, application arrives 13 July and acceptance occurs 23 July. What are fill and hire durations under course rules?
questions.explanation: Time-to-fill starts at approval; time-to-hire starts at application, excluding start day.

questions.question: Eligible cost is ₹84,000 for seven joined hires under an agreed allocation. What is cost per hire?
Source A has a higher joining rate but serves easier-to-fill roles. What should the recommendation consider?
options: Role mix, comparable cohorts, cost and downstream outcomes
That source A is causally superior
That all other sources should close immediately
questions.explanation: Context can explain rate differences without a source effect.

questions.question: Two interviewers disagree strongly on a work sample. What is the most useful next step?
options: Reject the candidate for causing disagreement
Compare job-related evidence against behavioural anchors
Average and assume bias is eliminated
questions.explanation: Calibration examines the basis of judgement.

questions.question: Only 12 of 40 rejected candidates respond to feedback. What is the response rate and key caveat?
A dashboard shows low average fill time after excluding every open vacancy. What complementary view is needed?
options: A claim that no delays remain
Age and status of open requisitions
questions.explanation: Unfinished work can contain the longest unresolved delays.

questions.question: A candidate criticises scheduling in a survey. What should the team avoid?
options: Using criticism as an adverse selection signal
questions.explanation: Feedback should inform process quality, not punish respondents.
